column1: # One row per item the adaptive runner may place. The runner reads ONLY
# this manifest; the model session worktree never sees it. Every item is
# RED-proof: its grader (in graders/<item_id>.py, dispatched OOB by
# "gate","reason"} derived from the worktree's OBJECTIVE state, never the
#   item_id              unique id (== grader_key the daemon dispatches on)
#                       legacy fleet class on this column is normalized at
#                       read time, never stored as the canonical form
#   difficulty           integer 1..4 on the calibrated ladder
#   expected_pass_pct    calibration anchor: the % of known-good models
#                       expected to clear the item (MUST-PASS control
#   mode                 the failure mode the item catches (free-text;
#                       preflight.sh's T1–T12 modes are the historical
#                       vocabulary — this column reuses it where
#                       applicable, adds new modes for the new canonical
#   brief                the PROMPT.md filename the runner copies (under
#   grader_key           == item_id; the runner's request enqueues with
#   saturated            "1" if a MUST-PASS / MUST-FAIL split has been
#                       measured and the item discriminates; "0" if the
#                       item is in the bank on a calibration promise but
#                       the split is unverified. A "1" row is the
#                       discrimination proof; "0" rows are draft items
#                       the runner may use ONLY when no saturated item
#                       exists for the work_class (a calibration debt
#                       logged at the bottom of this file). Items with
#                       saturated="0" are NEVER promoted into the
#   control_pass         control model id expected to PASS (calibration
#                       anchor — the live runner's MUST-PASS control id)
#   control_fail         control model id expected to FAIL (calibration
#                       anchor — the live runner's MUST-FAIL control id,
# has >=1 item below — the F5 fix ("3 skills are 1 skill"). Items are
# split across difficulties so the adaptive runner can bracket a ceiling
# Calibration debt (unverified MUST-PASS / MUST-FAIL split). Listed here
# so the bank is auditable; the runner logs a WARN and skips these
# unless no saturated item exists for the work_class+difficulty.
# Calibration debt: legacy work_classes that the canonical mapping folds
# resolves these to 'coding' on read; the row is recorded under its raw
